latest_events.title: Burkina Faso’s rival armed groups turn on each other as state loses ground
latest_events.summary: Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso – Armed fighters from two rival groups have fought a series of increasingly deadly battles along Burkina Faso’s northern border with Mali, as the government struggles to reassert control over large parts of the country. latest_events.title: Koro, Sandaré and Sofara: Flood of fire on terrorists As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted airstrikes between 03 and 04 November 2026. These operations made it possible to target two bases of armed terrorist groups in different localities of our country.
latest_events.summary: According to the statement of the General Staff of the Armed Forces published this Thursday, the exploitation of precise intelligence on Tuesday, November 03, 2026 made it possible to locate, fifty-two (52) kilometers north-east of Koro, a base of armed terrorist groups housing several individuals as well as war equipment, including motorcycles and a fuel depot .

latest_events.title: Ghana: a deadly explosion kills several people near the Burkinabe border
latest_events.summary: An explosion involving a tricycle carrying suspected explosives killed several people on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, in Hamile, Upper West Region, Ghana. One immigration officer lost his life in the drama, while another was seriously injured. The locality of Hamile, located near the border between Ghana and Burkina Faso, was shaken by a deadly explosion .
